node.title: Minus-branch F2 coupled negacyclic top-window reduction
node.statement: For every official maximal rate-half p=3 mod 4 row, b=v_2(p+1)>=39 and ord_(2^41)(p)=2^max(1,41-b) is 2 or 4. At each exact or nested top window of order 2^40 or 2^41, the F2 kernel is the F_p coefficient code of polynomials divisible by the Frobenius-closed root polynomial on the first R odd powers. Its scalar rank is hR, where h=2 except at the nested top window where h=ord_(2^41)(p). Its weighted ternary mass has the exact L2 collision form and pointwise floor 2^m/p^(hR), and every nonzero ternary word has weight at least 2R+1. The code is Frobenius-coupled and its mass does not factor over singleton proportionality classes. No mass upper bound is claimed.
